Fictional illustrative art, not a real merchant photo or testimonial.
Style: Detailed isometric architectural miniature of a real small business, coherent floor layout, believable objects, refined miniature material textures and elevated camera.
Color direction: midnight blue, cream, warm amber.
Specific scene: Miniature cutaway of a small shop being carefully closed for a holiday: one worker checks the chilled cabinet, another finishes a wrapped pending order, owner places a blank opening note beside the till. Outside shutter halfway down, warm interior against cool night street. Three distinct practical closing tasks, physically coherent shop floor, no labels.
